notes.title: Click through the joy of opening up mystery boxes in Unboxathon
notes.notes:
If you love your chilled casual clicker games, Unboxathon could be a good one for you with a demo available to try.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/click-through-the-joy-of-opening-up-mystery-boxes-in-unboxathon/

notes.title: I Heard You! The big balancing update is here! 0.3.11v2
notes.notes: [p]I want to thank everyone for giving feedback, even when it's not the most constructive :P[/p][p]If this update changes how you feel about the game, please leave a review / update your review, it would help a lot! :)[/p][p]That being said, here are the patch notes![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes - Version 0.3.11v2[/b][/h2][h3][b]Upgrade Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Clicking speed effect increased from [b]0.05 → 0.075[/b], cost multiplier [b]5 → 7.5[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Cutting speed effect increased from [b]0.15 → 0.2[/b], cost multiplier [b]3.5 → 5[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Ricochet damage upgrade cost multiplier reduced from [b]3 → 2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Shiny item chance cost multiplier reduced from [b]20 → 10[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Cutting speed multiplier tablet upgrade cost reduced from [b]5000 → 1000[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Filling click damage money cost changed from [b]250 * 2.5 → 100 * 5[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Quest for ascending a box implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Item visualizer panel sizing slightly adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to bubbles not clicking well when overlapped.[/p][/*][*][p]Box thump/opening sound now scales with SFX volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Internal data comparison issues fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased base item value from [b]0.35 → 0.4[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased starting clicking speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Ricochet now starts off stronger, and should have way more impact early on.[/p][/*][*][p]Spike bubbles now launch spikes a bit further by default and move slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Metal fillings now always have 1 health.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chance to find shards.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo version 0.3.10
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed German language being selected for some users, even though localization does not exist yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some of the Russian translations being cut off early.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Balance + Localization Patch!
notes.notes: [p][b]Save data has been reset![/b][/p][p]I apologize for no notice earlier, I was not expecting having to do this! :/[/p][p]The balancing has hugely been improved though, which should lead to quite a different experience :)[/p][p][/p][p]Notable changes:[/p][list][*][p]You can now pop bubbles while a box is being cut open.[/p][/*][*][p]Ascending a box is way more powerful than before.[/p][/*][*][p]Sped up early power curve[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some rounding and float precision issues[/p][/*][*][p]Localization has been added! The game has 5 languages available right now, and will increase as we go.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the support![/p][p]-Skye <3[/p]
